identity.title: Guard impossible transform output allocations before native execution

origin.summary: The 2D-036 task requires checked output-size and byte estimates before Affine/RotateScale native allocation, while the measured 2D-034 baseline does not authorize a new product-wide memory cap.

state.current_summary: The latest smoke binaries pass the 2D-036 output-allocation contract in Debug and Release after the dispatcher correction; the focused WPF smoke remains green. The memory-budget/cap portion is still blocked for the explicit product decision.
state.next_action: Obtain an explicit product memory-budget/cap decision or explicitly accept arithmetic-only preflight; then define and verify the corresponding low-memory failure/recovery contract.
state.blocker: No approved product memory budget or user-facing cap exists. The 2D-034 baseline explicitly does not authorize inferring one from observed private-memory values.
state.unblock_condition: The product owner supplies the memory budget/cap, setting scope, failure message, and recovery behavior, or explicitly closes the memory-budget portion as out of scope.

objective.summary: Reject impossible Affine and RotateScale output dimensions or unrepresentable width×height×element-byte estimates before the SDK allocates native output, while preserving the existing successful result layer and leaving automatic downscaling and a product-wide memory cap out of scope.
constraints: Reuse VisionPipelineExecutionService, VisionPipelineValidation, existing Affine 32768 policy, and existing Preview executors.
Do not modify the vendored OpenVisionLab Vision SDK DLLs.
Do not introduce an inferred user-facing memory cap, cache policy, parallelism policy, or automatic downscale.

criteria.text: The shared guard derives Affine output dimensions from 0-or-explicit values and RotateScale dimensions from finite positive scales, rejects unsupported/overflow dimensions and checked byte multiplication before native execution, and reports an actionable error.

Focused contract evidence shows a normal Affine/RotateScale transform still succeeds, an impossible RotateScale or Affine output is rejected without native allocation, and a prior successful layer/result remains available after the rejected step.

The owner, call path, no-cap decision, report, stable contract, documentation map, and handoff identify the remaining product memory-budget decision and unverified WPF runtime states separately from the completed core guard.

context.summary: Recipe execution owner and native-call boundary.
Vendored SDK contains the native transform implementations and is not modified.

evidence.observation: Debug output-allocation preflight contract passed: normal RotateScale/Affine execution, non-finite and overflowing RotateScale rejection, Affine 32768 boundary, prior-result preservation, and direct Preview guard wiring.
Release output-allocation preflight contract passed with the same normal, rejected-output, prior-result, and Preview-owner cases.

The report records the guard owner/call path, mutable layer writer, no-inferred-RAM-cap decision, stable contract and documentation-map updates, and the remaining WPF/low-memory/cancellation/runtime boundaries.

Focused Debug WPF smoke passed for RotateScale and Affine. Fresh screenshots show the RotateScale preview output/status and Affine review/overlay. The initial run's cross-thread exception was corrected by dispatcher-marshalling the two direct Preview adapters.
Focused Release WPF smoke passed for RotateScale and Affine with screenshot and layout/text checks OK at the current environment.
Final Debug smoke contract passed after the dispatcher correction: normal RotateScale/Affine, non-finite/overflow rejection, Affine boundary, prior-result preservation, and Preview owner wiring.
Final Release smoke contract passed after the dispatcher correction with the same output-allocation and prior-result cases.
Latest Debug contract run passed after the final smoke rebuild; the arithmetic preflight and normal/rejected transform cases all exit 0.
Latest Release contract run passed after the final smoke rebuild; the arithmetic preflight and normal/rejected transform cases all exit 0.

events.summary: Safe arithmetic and native-dimension preflight is verified in Debug and Release; full 2D-036 memory-budget behavior is paused for the required product decision.
